MU_STREAM_BROKEN.title: Response stream was interrupted
MU_STREAM_BROKEN.body: mu accepted your message, but the reply stopped partway. Try again, and if it happens again, check the app log.

MU_STATE_INCONSISTENT.title: Conversation state is out of sync
MU_STATE_INCONSISTENT.body: Restart this conversation or reload the app, then try again.

MU_PERMISSION_ERROR.title: Couldn't access the requested resource
MU_PERMISSION_ERROR.body: A local permission or file system check failed. Check the project path and app permissions, then try again.

MU_INTERNAL_ERROR.title: mu couldn't process the request
MU_INTERNAL_ERROR.body: Something went wrong while mu was processing this request. Try again, and if it happens again, check the app log.

MU_CONVERSATION_BUSY.title: Conversation is busy
MU_CONVERSATION_BUSY.body: Another response is still running. Wait for it to finish before sending a new message.

USER_AGENT_NOT_INSTALLED.title: The selected agent isn't installed
USER_AGENT_NOT_INSTALLED.body: Install the CLI or app this agent needs, then reconnect it in Settings.

USER_AGENT_STARTUP_FAILED.title: The selected agent couldn't start
USER_AGENT_STARTUP_FAILED.body: The agent process exited before it was ready. Check its installation, sign-in status and local command settings.

USER_AGENT_OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_UNREACHABLE.title: Can't reach OpenClaw Gateway
USER_AGENT_OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_UNREACHABLE.body:
OpenClaw Gateway isn't running or can't be reached at 127.0.0.1:18789.

Start it and try again. You can run:
openclaw gateway status
openclaw gateway start

USER_AGENT_DISCONNECTED.title: The selected agent disconnected
USER_AGENT_DISCONNECTED.body: The agent connection closed while handling this message. Restart or reconnect the agent, then try again.

USER_AGENT_AUTH_REQUIRED.title: The selected agent needs you to sign in
USER_AGENT_AUTH_REQUIRED.body: Sign in to the agent or refresh its credentials, then send the message again.

USER_AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.title: The agent session was lost
USER_AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.body: The agent doesn't recognize this session anymore. Start a new conversation to continue.

USER_AGENT_UNSUPPORTED_METHOD.title: The selected agent doesn't support this action
USER_AGENT_UNSUPPORTED_METHOD.body: The agent says the requested ACP method isn't supported or available.

USER_AGENT_INVALID_PARAMS.title: The selected agent rejected the request
USER_AGENT_INVALID_PARAMS.body: The agent says the request parameters are invalid.

USER_AGENT_HANDSHAKE_FAILED.title: Agent handshake failed
USER_AGENT_HANDSHAKE_FAILED.body: The selected agent couldn't complete its startup handshake. Restart or reconnect the agent, then try again.

USER_AGENT_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT.title: Agent handshake timed out
USER_AGENT_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT.body: The selected agent didn't finish its startup handshake in time. Check whether it's still starting or stuck, then try again.

USER_AGENT_ACP_INIT_FAILED.title: Agent protocol initialization failed
USER_AGENT_ACP_INIT_FAILED.body: The app couldn't start an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) session with this agent.

USER_AGENT_PROTOCOL_PARSE_ERROR.title: The agent reported a protocol parse error
USER_AGENT_PROTOCOL_PARSE_ERROR.body: The agent couldn't parse an ACP/JSON-RPC message.

USER_AGENT_INVALID_REQUEST.title: The agent reported an invalid protocol request
USER_AGENT_INVALID_REQUEST.body: The agent says the ACP/JSON-RPC request object is invalid.

USER_AGENT_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.title: The agent couldn't find a required resource
USER_AGENT_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.body: The agent couldn't find a resource it needs, such as a file.

USER_AGENT_PROTOCOL_ERROR.title: The agent returned a protocol error
USER_AGENT_PROTOCOL_ERROR.body: The selected agent returned a non-standard ACP error code.

USER_AGENT_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH.title: Agent protocol versions are incompatible
USER_AGENT_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH.body: The app and the agent don't share a compatible ACP version.

USER_AGENT_NO_PREVIOUS_SESSION.title: Previous agent session is unavailable
USER_AGENT_NO_PREVIOUS_SESSION.body: The agent can't resume the previous session. Start a new conversation to continue.

USER_AGENT_COMMAND_NOT_FOUND.title: Agent command not found
USER_AGENT_COMMAND_NOT_FOUND.body: Couldn't find the configured agent command. Install it or update the command path in Settings.

USER_AGENT_MISSING_ENV.title: The agent is missing required environment variables
USER_AGENT_MISSING_ENV.body: The agent needs environment variables that aren't set. Add them in Settings or your shell, then reconnect.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED.title: Model provider authentication failed
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED.body: The selected provider rejected the API key or account credentials. Check the provider settings and try again.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_AWS_SSO_EXPIRED.title: AWS SSO session expired
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_AWS_SSO_EXPIRED.body: Your AWS SSO session has expired. Run 'aws sso login' for the matching profile, then send the message again.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_CONFIG_ERROR.title: Model provider configuration is invalid
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_CONFIG_ERROR.body: Couldn't build a request from the current provider settings. Check the credentials, region, base URL and other provider settings, then try again.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_MODEL_NOT_FOUND.title: Couldn't find the selected model
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_MODEL_NOT_FOUND.body: The provider doesn't recognize this model name. Choose an available model in Settings and try again.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED.title: Model provider rate limit reached
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED.body: The provider is temporarily limiting requests. Wait a moment, send requests less often or switch models.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT.title: Model provider request timed out
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT.body: The provider didn't respond in time. Try again later or switch to a more reliable provider.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_NETWORK_ERROR.title: Couldn't reach the model provider
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_NETWORK_ERROR.body: A network or DNS error blocked the connection to the provider. Check your network, proxy and base URL.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_GATEWAY_ERROR.title: Model provider service is unavailable
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_GATEWAY_ERROR.body: The provider returned a gateway or service error. Try again later or use another provider.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Model provider permission denied
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_PERMISSION_DENIED.body: Your provider account doesn't have permission for this model or operation. Check the account's permissions or choose another model.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_BILLING_REQUIRED.title: The provider needs billing or credits
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_BILLING_REQUIRED.body: The selected provider needs active billing, credits or quota before it can complete this request.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED_MODEL.title: Model doesn't support this request
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED_MODEL.body: The selected model is unavailable or doesn't support the requested capability. Choose a supported model and try again.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND.title: Couldn't find the provider's endpoint
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND.body: The provider couldn't find the endpoint or API path. Check the base URL, deployment name and API compatibility.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_REQUEST.title: Model provider rejected the request
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_REQUEST.body: The provider says the request is invalid. Simplify the message or check the model and provider settings.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_TOOL_SCHEMA.title: The provider rejected a tool schema
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_INVALID_TOOL_SCHEMA.body: The provider rejected a tool definition in this request. Update the agent or turn off the incompatible tool, then try again.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE.title: Context is too large for the model
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE.body: The request exceeds the model's context limit. Shorten the message, reference fewer files or start a new conversation.

USER_LLM_PROVIDER_EMPTY_RESPONSE.title: Model provider returned an empty response
USER_LLM_PROVIDER_EMPTY_RESPONSE.body: The provider finished the request without any usable content. Try again, and switch providers if it keeps happening.

WORKSPACE_PATH_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.title: The agent couldn't run in this project folder
WORKSPACE_PATH_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.body: Make sure the project folder exists.
WORKSPACE_PATH_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.bodyWithPath: The agent couldn't run in "{{workspacePath}}". Make sure the folder exists.

UNKNOWN_UPSTREAM_ERROR.title: The agent or provider returned an error
UNKNOWN_UPSTREAM_ERROR.body: mu got an error but couldn't tell whether it came from the agent, the provider, the network or your computer.

MCP_HTTP_RESPONSE_READ_FAILED.title: Couldn't read the team helper's response
MCP_HTTP_RESPONSE_READ_FAILED.body: mu couldn't read the response from the local team helper. Try again, and if it keeps happening, restart the app.

MCP_TOOL_REMOTE_ERROR.title: The local team helper rejected the request
MCP_TOOL_REMOTE_ERROR.body: The local team helper returned an error for this request. Check the details below, adjust the team action and try again.

MCP_TOOL_RESPONSE_UNEXPECTED.title: The team helper returned an unexpected response
MCP_TOOL_RESPONSE_UNEXPECTED.body: mu got an unexpected response from the local team helper. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.

MCP_TCP_READ_FAILED.title: Couldn't read from the local team helper
MCP_TCP_READ_FAILED.body: mu couldn't read the TCP response from the local team helper. Try again, and restart the app if it keeps failing.

TEAM_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Team service isn't ready yet
TEAM_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.body: The local team session is still starting or was interrupted. Wait a moment and try again.

TEAM_ASSISTANT_ID_REQUIRED.title: Select an assistant for this teammate
TEAM_ASSISTANT_ID_REQUIRED.body: Choose an existing assistant from the catalog before creating or adding a teammate.

TEAM_ASSISTANT_NOT_FOUND.title: The selected assistant is no longer available
TEAM_ASSISTANT_NOT_FOUND.body: Refresh the assistant catalog, then choose another assistant for this teammate.

TEAM_ASSISTANT_FIELD_UNSUPPORTED.title: The request used a legacy team identity field
TEAM_ASSISTANT_FIELD_UNSUPPORTED.body: This team action must use assistant_id instead of legacy backend or agent fields.
